review_description: Everything went smooth from start to finish. Straight forward no messing around Honest about everything, the work come out really good

Onsite visit and quote, various phone conversations and questions answered. Disconnection of existing solar hot water and removal of previous solar panels was efficient and cleaned up well.  Installation was rescheduled once, but on the day multiple tradies on time efficient polite well organised workers, finished within 6 hours. Grid connection and website for monitoring usage all connected and checked before leaving.
